resources.string: Allows Chitti to lock the phone on your voice command. Chitti will NEVER unlock — Android does not expose any unlock API to apps.
Chitti can tap the WhatsApp send button after you say "haan" — for blind / mute / illiterate users who cannot tap themselves. Scope is strictly limited to the WhatsApp send button.
Namaste, main Chitti hun, ek AI assistant. Main aapki taraf se baat kar rahi hun.
This is Chitti AI. The user is sleeping. Is this an emergency?
Wake up master, emergency call from %1$s
Thank you. Please call back after six AM.
